newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts $819 mln trade gap March 1-21.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts $819 mln trade gap March 1-21.

text.p: Brazil posted a trade gap of $819 million up to March 21, with imports in the first three weeks of the month at $3.629 billion and exports at $2.81 billion, a spokeswoman for the Ministry of Industry and Commerce said.
Average daily exports so far this month were $187.3 million while imports averaged $241.9 million a day, the spokeswoman said.
In the third week of March, exports totalled $987 million, for a daily average of $197.4 million. Imports stood at $1.35 billion or $270 million a day.
